title: Is AI "Too Dangerous to Release" if we can’t secure the release itself?
excerpt: The reported breach of Claude Mythos proves that "god-like" AI intelligence is useless if we can’t master the basics of credential management and supply chain security.
author: Alessio Miccichè

title: Elon Musk recently proposed Universal High Income
excerpt: Universal High Income is a bold vision, but building a permanent global welfare system on a "productivity surplus" that doesn't yet exist is a high-stakes gamble with history. While AI promises post-scarcity, the growing cracks in the industry's profitability and rising costs suggest we may be repeating the catastrophic valuation mistakes of the dot-com era.
author: Alessio Miccichè

title: Why AI's Vertical Obsession is a Trap
excerpt: We are building "God Models" with unsustainable energy costs, creating a thermodynamic catastrophe masquerading as innovation. To avoid a dot-com style collapse, we must pivot from massive centralized clusters to efficient, localized "horizontal" growth.
author: Alessio Miccichè
